# Know What I don’t Know: Handling Ambiguous and Unanswerable Questions for Text-to-SQL

[All reading notes](../reading-notes.md) · [Catalog entry](../README.md#dte-noisysp)

**Full paper read · 2026-11-09**

[Original source](https://aclanthology.org/2023.findings-acl.352.pdf) · Findings of ACL 2023, pages 5701-5714; proceedings PDF title uses “Unanswerable”, while the Anthology landing record uses “Unknown”

**Reading coverage:** All fourteen PDF pages, Sections 1-7, limitations, Appendices A-C, error examples and checklist; Tables 1-11 and figure data/captions read.

## Research question

A parser may emit plausible SQL despite missing or ambiguous concepts in a question/table pair.

## Method

A six-category analysis motivates NoisySP, but generation mainly edits schemas to create column ambiguity and missing-column cases. DTE combines BERT concept prediction, grounding and CRF span labeling using SQL-derived weak supervision, then instantiates explanation templates.

## Evaluation

Experiments use NoisySP with WikiSQL and SQL-annotated WTQ, plus a separate 3,000-question commercial failure sample. Metrics assess token-label and grounding accuracy. A separate WTQ experiment measures ordinary answerable-query SQL accuracy.

## What the results support

DTE improves problematic-span labeling and grounding over adapted heuristics/ETA. Reported realistic-data AMB and UNK label accuracies are 75.2% and 70.2%. Most analyzed residual errors involve span boundaries, and SQL gains on ordinary WTQ are small.

## Limits and qualifications

The 20% problematic-question estimate comes from collected failed requests, not an unbiased rate over all user traffic. Synthetic training principally covers two of six categories. Missing values and unsupported calculations follow operational product conventions; these are not universal proofs of unanswerability. Complete clarification-to-SQL success is not evaluated.

## Relevance to reliable Text-to-SQL

Separates detection, localization and explanation, making it a useful pre-generation diagnostic baseline.
